title: Protection paladin: keeps Holy Shield and Bulwark up while tanking three mobs

rules.desc: The Protection paladin casts Holy Shield at least 2 times per minute of scored fight time
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:62-64 (holy shield at ACTION_HIGH + 3); ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinTriggers.h:62-63 (HolyShieldTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: holy shield sits above every seal and judgement row and re-casts on cooldown while tanking; three mobs keep the row active. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: The Protection paladin casts Bulwark of the Righteous at least once in the fight
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:66-68 (bulwark of the righteous at ACTION_HIGH + 2); ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinTriggers.h:120 (BulwarkTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: bulwark sits just below holy shield in the same band and needs its 300 s cooldown and a shield in hand; the talent needs the level-50 premade (the level-40 build stops short) and the per-rep cooldown reset clears the reused hire

rules.desc: Precondition: the Protection paladin holds Righteous Fury (aura 20450, 25780 or 25781) for at least 95 percent of its in-combat samples, so the mitigation rows fire on a tank with threat
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:252-272 (righteous fury rows in and out of combat, ACTION_NORMAL + 1); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the buff rows keep Righteous Fury up through the fight (the tank-paladin-righteous-fury trial); without it the mitigation numbers mean nothing. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
